resources.string: Turn a bloated Android TV into a clean one from your phone. Disable apps safely, install a launcher, and keep a backup you can restore.
On the TV, turn on USB debugging (Developer options) and Network/ADB debugging, then accept \"Allow USB debugging\" when it appears.
Looking for TVs advertising ADB. The phone and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Android 11 and newer: open Wireless debugging on the TV, tap \"Pair device with pairing code\", then enter the port and the 6-digit code here.
How do I turn on ADB?

1. Settings > About > tap Build 7 times.
2. Developer options > USB debugging on.
3. Developer options > Network/ADB debugging on (Android 11+).
4. Keep the phone and the TV on the same Wi-Fi.
5. If the TV asks, accept "Allow USB debugging".

The default port is 5555. Some TVs use a different one; the pairing dialog shows it.
No backup yet. One is written before the first change, and can be restored from here.
Fire TV: the launcher takeover is not supported. Cleaning and restoring still work.
Choose the list for this TV
Search by model, brand or Android version
No list matches. Try the model name or browse all lists.
CVTE board: the stock launcher stays enabled unless this TV\'s example list disables it. Home is set with set-home-activity and checked after a reboot.
Choose the launcher APK built from this project (launcher/app). It is installed and set as Home after the TV\'s stock launcher is confirmed working.
Keep the APK on the phone until the run finishes. Home is only switched after the new launcher answers.
Sets Private DNS to dns.adguard-dns.com. It blocks ads at the DNS level and is recorded in the backup so it can be restored.
The backup is written before the first change. Every disabled app can be restored from this phone.
Keep the phone connected and the TV awake. Do not close the app while it runs.
Keep this screen open and the TV awake. The run stops safely if the connection drops; the backup stays available.
Keep this screen open and the TV awake until every app is back.
The apps in the backup are enabled again. Reboot the TV, then check that Home and the remote still work.
The restore result is unavailable. Reconnect to the TV and restore again.
Every app this run disabled is enabled again. Apps that were already disabled before the run stay as they were.
The apps are disabled. Reboot the TV and check Home, the remote and the inputs before closing ADB.
The backup could not be read. Check the TV state before doing anything else.
This run did not finish. The backup is still valid; restore it if the TV looks wrong.
Reboot the TV now? Wait for it to come back, then reconnect and check Home and ADB.
Turn off USB debugging and Network/ADB debugging on the TV, revoke USB debugging authorisations, and reboot. Port 5555 is unencrypted.
Enter the TV\'s IP address first.
Enter the TV IP, the pairing port and the 6-digit code.
Connect to the same TV before restoring.
Reboot sent. Wait for the TV, then reconnect and check Home and ADB.
Connecting. Accept the Allow USB debugging prompt on the TV.
Pairing with the TV. Keep the pairing dialog open.
That file is not an Android APK.
Timed out. Check the IP and port, keep the TV awake, and accept the Allow USB debugging prompt.
The TV refused the connection. Turn on USB debugging (and Network/ADB debugging) first.
The TV did not authorise this phone. Accept the Allow USB debugging prompt on the TV, then retry.
Pairing failed. The pairing port changes every time the dialog opens; check the port and code.
